text:
Which statement about copper or aluminium is correct?
A
Aluminium is more dense than copper.
B
Aluminium is less reactive than copper.
C
Copper has high ductility.
D
Copper has poor electrical conductivity.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium is more dense than copper.

options.label: B
options.text: Aluminium is less reactive than copper.
